inputs.text: KTR is accusing the Congress government of letting illegal mining continue while a company he says belongs to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved. That looks less like an isolated failure and more like the sort of protection insiders get when powerful interests are involved. The account is only a fragment, but even the accusation points to a convenient arrangement: public inaction, private benefit, and a political system that would rather control the story than confront it.
